onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Cobaltium
onboarding.welcome.body: Your language-learning companion — chat with a tutor, save what you learn, and review it until it sticks.
onboarding.model.title: Set up your AI tutor
onboarding.model.body: This drawer holds the model options. For a beginner, the Cloud option is easiest — no big download, you just add a key. We'll walk through each step.
onboarding.modes.title: Chat: four modes — Conversation, Corrective, Immersive and Reflective.
onboarding.modes.body: You write in your native language. Your words are translated into the learning language and the assistant replies only in that language.
onboarding.study.title: Review: flashcard decks built from your saved words.
onboarding.study.body: They land in your Lexicon for review and grammar.
tour.chat.title: The Chat window
tour.chat.body: This is where you chat with your personal language tutor. From here you'll also reach your sessions and your AI settings. Tap anywhere on the screen to move through the tour.
tour.modes.title: Four chat modes
tour.modes.body: Conversation, Corrective, Immersive and Reflective change how your tutor replies.
tour.input.title: Write your message
tour.input.body: Type here and press Send. In Reflective mode you write in your native language and a flip card shows your learning-language version.
tour.lang.title: Learning language
tour.lang.body: This is the language you want to learn. Everything you're corrected on or you reflect on shows up here, helping you think in it.
tour.lexicon.title: Lexicon
tour.lexicon.body: Every word and phrase you save in the chat or Reader lands here. Tap one to see its meaning, grammar, and more — or look up any word with LangDex.
tour.review.title: Review
tour.review.body: This is your spaced-repetition trainer. The words and phrases you save become flashcards that come back for review just before you'd forget them.
tour.reader.title: Reader
tour.reader.body: Read EPUB books with a tap-to-translate gloss on every word — great for reading practice in the language you're learning.
tour.scenarios.title: Scenarios
tour.scenarios.body: Scenarios puts you in real-world situations — ordering at a café, visiting a doctor, catching a flight, and more. Each one is a mini-lesson with vocabulary, phrases, and dialogue.
tour.model.title: Set up your AI tutor
tour.model.body: This drawer holds the model options. For a beginner, the Cloud option is easiest — no big download, you just add a key. We'll walk through each step.
tour.done.title: You're all set
tour.done.body: Reopen this tour any time from Settings.
tour.modes.conversation.title: Conversation Mode
tour.modes.conversation.body: Free-form chat. Ask questions about words, grammar, and usage in any language.
tour.modes.corrective.title: Corrective Mode
tour.modes.corrective.body: You write in the language you are learning. The assistant checks your sentences, explains mistakes, and shows the corrected version.
tour.modes.immersive.title: Immersive Mode
tour.modes.immersive.body: You write in your native language. Your words are translated into the learning language and the assistant replies only in that language.
tour.modes.reflective.title: Reflective Mode
tour.modes.reflective.body: Send a message in your native language; a flip card shows its translation so you can reflect on how it reads in the learning language.
tour.lang.helper.title: Helping language
tour.lang.helper.body: This is the language you already know — the tutor's explanations, corrections and glosses appear in it. Pick the one you're most comfortable with.
tour.lang.learn.title: Learning language
tour.lang.learn.body: This is the language you want to learn. Everything you're corrected on or you reflect on shows up here, helping you think in it.
tour.lang.flip.title: Flip languages
tour.lang.flip.body: Tap this to instantly swap your helping and learning languages — handy when you're reviewing from the other direction.
tour.tool.glossary.title: Word glossary
tour.tool.glossary.body: Turn on this tool, then tap any word to see its meaning and grammar — ambiguity, conjugation, and more.
tour.tool.select.title: Select words
tour.tool.select.body: Tap this to select several words at once so you can act on them together, e.g. to save a phrase.
tour.tool.save.title: Save
tour.tool.save.body: Saves the selected words or phrase to your Lexicon for flashcards and grammar lookups.
tour.tool.granular.title: Save one word
tour.tool.granular.body: Tap this, then tap a single word to save just that word — no need to select it first.
tour.tool.speak.title: Speak
tour.tool.speak.body: Plays the selected text aloud so you can hear how it sounds.
tour.tool.translit.title: Transliteration
tour.tool.translit.body: Adds a romanized line under words when the two languages use different scripts (like English and Hebrew).
tour.tts.title: No voice for a language?
tour.tts.body: If audio isn't available for a language pair, the voice goes through your operating system's text-to-speech. Install the voice pack for that language in your OS settings — it will load after a restart.
tour.llm.intro.title: Set up your AI tutor
tour.llm.intro.body: The Settings page holds the model options. For a beginner, the Cloud option is easiest — no big download, you just add a key. We'll walk through each step.
tour.llm.provider.title: Provider
tour.llm.provider.body: Cloud runs the AI on a remote server through an OpenAI-compatible vendor — quick to set up. Local runs on your own machine, which is private but needs a local server such as Ollama.
tour.llm.apikey.title: Paste your API key
tour.llm.apikey.body: Paste the key here. It's stored encrypted and shown masked, so your key stays private.
tour.llm.baseurl.title: Base URL
tour.llm.baseurl.body: Usually pre-filled by your chosen vendor. Leave it as-is unless you use a custom endpoint.
tour.llm.model.title: Model
tour.llm.model.body: Which model to use. A recommended default is pre-filled — you can keep it.
tour.llm.maxtokens.title: Max tokens
tour.llm.maxtokens.body: How long the tutor may reply. The default is fine for most lessons.
tour.llm.temperature.title: Temperature
tour.llm.temperature.body: Controls how creative versus precise the tutor is. Leave the default unless you know what you're changing.
tour.llm.enable.title: Turn it on
tour.llm.enable.body: Finally, flip 'Enable LLM' on to start chatting with your tutor.
tour.llm.done.title: All set
tour.llm.done.body: That's the AI setup. You can revisit these options any time from Settings. Now let's look at your sessions.
tour.sessions.title: Your sessions
tour.sessions.body: This sidebar lists every conversation you've had. Open one here to jump back to it, star the ones you love, and rename or delete them.
tour.new.session.title: Start fresh
tour.new.session.body: To start a brand-new conversation, use the '+' button in the sessions sidebar.
tour.drawers.done.title: Chat window done
tour.drawers.done.body: You've covered the Chat window. Next, the tour will take you through Review, Reader, Scenarios and Lexicon.
tour.ext.intro.title: Translation engine
tour.ext.intro.body: Cobaltium translates with a built-in engine, and it works offline. If you would like higher quality web translation instead, you can connect your own DeepL or Google Translate API key here.
tour.ext.deepl.title: DeepL
tour.ext.deepl.body: Paste your DeepL API key here. Choose Free or Pro to match your DeepL account — the two use different endpoints. Keys are stored encrypted on your device.
tour.ext.google.title: Google Translate
tour.ext.google.body: Paste a Google Cloud Translation API key here. Unlike DeepL, Google Translate covers every language Cobaltium supports.
tour.ext.picker.title: Pick your provider
tour.ext.picker.body: This menu chooses which external engine is active. DeepL and Google are mutually exclusive — only one can be used at a time.
tour.ext.toggle.title: Translate with it
tour.ext.toggle.body: Enable fast translation and Cobaltium sends translations to an external engine instead of the built-in one. It only switches on once a key is saved.
tour.ext.done.title: Optional by default
tour.ext.done.body: No key? No problem. Without one, translations keep using the built-in engine — external engines are purely a choice you can make anytime.
tour.themes.button.title: Themes
tour.themes.button.body: This palette button opens your Themes menu — where you pick Cobaltium's look: Light, Dark, System, or a themed palette like Charcoal, Pitch Black, Blossom or Nature.
tour.themes.menu.title: Your Themes menu
tour.themes.menu.body: It just opened for you. Every theme shows a live preview — click one to apply it instantly. When you're done, close it to continue the tour.
tour.themes.done.title: That's the chat window!
tour.themes.done.body: You've now seen everything in the chat window. Coming up next: let's take a look at Review!
tour.srs.intro.title: Review
tour.srs.intro.body: This is your spaced-repetition trainer. The words and phrases you save become flashcards that come back for review just before you'd forget them.
tour.srs.page.title: Your decks
tour.srs.page.body: Each deck is a set of flashcards. The colored numbers show your progress: blue is new, yellow is learning, red needs review, and green is known well.
tour.srs.flip.title: Flip and grade
tour.srs.flip.body: Tap 'Reveal' to flip a card and see its meaning, say it aloud, then grade yourself: Again, Good, or Easy. Cards reschedule based on how well you know them.
tour.srs.drawer.title: Build a deck
tour.srs.drawer.body: This sidebar is how you build decks. Select the saved words and phrases you want, then add them to a deck — creating one first if you don't have one.
tour.srs.done.title: Review done
tour.srs.done.body: That's Review — cards built from your saved words, reviewed right before you forget. Next up, the Reader.
tour.reader.intro.title: Reader
tour.reader.intro.body: Read EPUB books with a tap-to-translate gloss on every word — great for reading practice in the language you're learning.
tour.reader.topbar.title: The book bar
tour.reader.topbar.body: Use Open to load an EPUB, set the book's language and your target language, and switch between Read and Edit modes.
tour.reader.gloss.title: Tap any word
tour.reader.gloss.body: Tap a word to see its translation and grammar right in context. Select text to listen to it or save it to your words.
tour.reader.tools.title: Reader tools
tour.reader.tools.body: These buttons speak, save, or transliterate the text you select — just like the tools in the Chat window.
tour.reader.lock.title: Navigate chapters
tour.reader.lock.body: Use the chapter bar to move between chapters, and gloss the whole chapter at once for full translations.
tour.reader.done.title: Reader done
tour.reader.done.body: That's the Reader. Next up is Scenarios.
tour.scenarios.intro.title: Scenarios
tour.scenarios.intro.body: Scenarios puts you in real-world situations — ordering at a café, visiting a doctor, catching a flight, and more. Each one is a mini-lesson with vocabulary, phrases, and dialogue.
tour.scenarios.grid.title: Scenario cards
tour.scenarios.grid.body: Browse the cards and tap one to start. Each card shows the scenario title, a short description, and its category.
tour.scenarios.filter.title: Category filters
tour.scenarios.filter.body: Use the category list to filter by topic — Home, Business, Fitness, Medical, Travel, and more.
tour.scenarios.card.title: Inside a scenario
tour.scenarios.card.body: Inside a scenario you get three sections: Vocabulary (words with translations and examples), Phrases (useful expressions), and Dialogues (sample conversations between two speakers).
tour.scenarios.done.title: Scenarios done
tour.scenarios.done.body: That's Scenarios. The final stop is Lexicon and LangDex.
tour.lex.intro.title: Lexicon
tour.lex.intro.body: Every word and phrase you save in the chat or Reader lands here. Tap one to see its meaning, grammar, and more — or look up any word with LangDex.
tour.lex.page.title: Your saved words
tour.lex.page.body: Use the filter to show one language at a time. Tap a word to open its details, or use Conjugate / Decline on a word to see its full inflection in LangDex.
tour.langdex.open.title: LangDex
tour.langdex.open.body: LangDex looks up the full inflection of any word — conjugation, declension, and more — even words you haven't saved.
tour.langdex.search.title: Look up a word
tour.langdex.search.body: Type a word and tap Look up to see its complete conjugation or declension. For tonal languages like Chinese, LangDex also covers tones, aspect and measure words.
tour.langdex.done.title: You're all set
tour.langdex.done.body: You've now seen every window in Cobaltium — Chat, Review, Reader, Scenarios and Lexicon. Happy learning!
tour.safety.title: Your safety
tour.safety.body: Cobaltium is a language-learning app. The assistant will not generate harmful content, and you can report anything inappropriate with the report button.
tour.safety.bullet1: Cobaltium will not generate harmful content, no matter how you ask.
tour.safety.bullet2: Found something inappropriate? Use the report button in the chat, reader, or Lexicon to send it to our support team.
tour.skipConfirmTitle: Skip the rest of the tour?
tour.skipConfirmBody: You can reopen it any time from Settings.

settings.fastTranslation.title: Fast translation
settings.fastTranslation.description: Use a fast local endpoint (for example a Qwen model served over Tailscale) for translations. When disabled or unavailable, Cobaltium falls back to DeepL, Google, or the LLM.
settings.fastTranslation.baseUrlHint: Point at a running OpenAI-compatible server, for example a Qwen model over Tailscale.
settings.backup.title: Backup & import
settings.backup.description: Export everything (database + settings) to a zip file, restore it later, or import a cobaltium.chat export from another device. Restoring replaces local data and relaunches the app.
settings.backup.restoreConfirm: Restoring replaces all local data. Click Restore again within a few seconds to confirm.
settings.reminders.title: Reminders
settings.reminders.hint: Show a desktop notification (at most once a day) when flashcards are due, with a tray icon while the app runs.
settings.voice.micHint: Required for voice mode. The app asks for microphone permission on first use.
settings.stt.title: Offline speech recognition
settings.stt.description: Download a whisper.cpp model for fully offline speech recognition in voice mode.
settings.stt.engineMissing: The speech recognition engine is not available on this platform; voice mode needs a local build (pnpm build:whisper).
